home.startTutorial: Click continue to start the home page tutorial
home.navigationDescription: Here you can navigate between the Planossauro pages.
home.profileDescription: Here you can view the user profile, modify the system theme and language.
home.plansDescription: Here you can view and manage your plan.
home.planningsDescription: Here you can view the created plannings.
home.createDescription: Here you can create a new lesson planning.
home.tutorialDescription: If you need a complete app tutorial, feel free to click the View tutorial button
home.generalInfoDescription: Here you will find general information about your account, such as your current plan, number of plannings you can create, and buttons to access the plan and create plannings
home.supportDescription: If you have any questions, feel free to click the button below
home.tutorFloatDescription: Click the icon to see the tutorial for each page, just go to the page and click to see the tutorial
home.hamburgerMenuDescription: This is the mobile devices version menu.

design.startTutorial: Click continue to start the planning page tutorial
design.selectTypeDescription: Here you can select the type of planning you want to use. Daily or Weekly
design.planningDescription: Here is where you will create your planning
design.planningDaysDescription: Here we will have the days in the weekly planning
design.weekChangeDescription: Click here to change the week
design.planningProgressDescription: If you see a small clock it means you need to enter the planning data for that day
design.repositionDescription: Click and hold with the mouse and move the item to reorder in the list
design.repositionMobileDescription: Click the buttons to move activities in the list
design.repositionDragDescription: Click, hold and drag up or down to reposition the activity
design.repositionButtonsDescription: Click up or down to change the position of the activity in the list
design.planningDescriptionTextDescription: Here you can enter a description of the planning
design.startTimeDescription: Enter the start time of the activity
design.endTimeDescription: Enter the end time of the activity
design.endTimeAltDescription: Here you can set the end time of the activity
design.previousDayDescription: Click here to go back to the previous day
design.addActivityDescription: Click here to add a new activity
design.nextDayDescription: Click here to advance to the next day
design.generatePlanDescription: Click here to generate the lesson planning after filling in all days of activities
design.generateDailyDescription: Click here to generate the week's daily

planning_list.startTutorial: Click continue to start the tutorial
planning_list.searchFormDescription: Use this form to search for plannings, we will filter the plannings and show only those that match your parameters
planning_list.noResultsDescription: If you don't see the focused screen, don't worry, you have registered plannings, but if focused, it means it's time to create your first planning
planning_list.planningListDescription: Here you will see the list of registered plannings
planning_list.editPlanningDescription: Click to edit the basic information of the planning, such as the date and archive it

plan.startTutorial: Click continue to start the tutorial
plan.planInfoDescription: Here you will find the information of your current plan
plan.nextBillingDescription: Displays the date of the next billing amount, if you are on the free plan, it will show the next time the tokens will be reset
plan.planStatusDescription: Provides the payment status of the current plan
plan.creditCardDescription: Displays the last 4 digits of the credit card linked to the plan
plan.changeCardDescription: Allows you to change the credit card linked to the plan, you will be redirected to a page to manage plannings and payments
plan.changePlanDescription: Allows you to change the current plan
plan.cancelPlanDescription: Allows you to cancel the current plan, if you cancel the plan, your plan will return to the free demonstration plan
plan.paymentHistoryDescription: Displays the history of payments made

profile.profileDescription: This is your profile, here you can see your information and configure the app.
profile.fullNameDescription: This is your full name. This name will be used to be inserted inside the plannings
profile.githubEmailDescription: This is your GitHub email. This email is used to log into the system
profile.googleEmailDescription: This is your Google email. This email is used to log into the system
profile.cellphoneDescription: This is your cellphone. This number will be used to send notifications
profile.updateInfoDescription: Click here to update your information
profile.additionalDetailsDescription: Here you can see which accounts are validated, and you can also delete your account, however you need to have at least 1 validated account to do so
profile.validateEmailDescription: Click here to send a validation email
profile.settingsDescription: Here you can configure your application preferences
profile.languageSettingsDescription: Here you can configure the application language
profile.themeSettingsDescription: Switch between light and dark theme here
profile.documentationDescription: By clicking this button you can access the documentation page
profile.helpSupportDescription: Click here to access the contact form for system assistance
profile.logoutDescription: Click here to exit the system

default.startTutorial: Click continue to start the tutorial
default.homePageDescription: Click here to return to the home page, there you can see the complete system tutorial
